'''Korriban's orbital security station''' was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="return" /> in [[3681 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> The [[Orbital security station/Legends|station]] was [[Battle of Korriban|attacked]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the early stages of the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="return" /> It was primarily used to monitor the [[Horuset system|Korriban system]], to prevent any Sith sympathizers acquiring [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and to prevent [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] from stealing them.
